# TransformJS

TransformJS is a privacy-first browser-based developer toolkit.

## Main tools

- JSON Formatter: https://transformjs.com/json
- Base64 Encoder / Decoder: https://transformjs.com/base64
- URL Encoder / Decoder: https://transformjs.com/url-encoder-decoder
- HTML Preview: https://transformjs.com/html-preview
- Markdown Preview: https://transformjs.com/markdown-preview
- JWT Debugger: https://transformjs.com/jwt-debugger
- YAML to JSON: https://transformjs.com/yaml-to-json
- SQL Formatter: https://transformjs.com/sql-formatter
- Hash Generator: https://transformjs.com/hash-generator
- Password Generator: https://transformjs.com/password-generator
- CSV to JSON: https://transformjs.com/csv-to-json
- RegEx Tester: https://transformjs.com/regex-tester
- FTL Previewer: https://transformjs.com/ftl-previewer
- Case Converter: https://transformjs.com/case-converter
- UUID Generator: https://transformjs.com/uuid-generator
- URL Parser: https://transformjs.com/url-parser
- Diff Checker: https://transformjs.com/diff-checker
- Color Converter: https://transformjs.com/color-converter

## Alternative pages

- Best DevToys Alternative: https://transformjs.com/alternatives/devtoys
- Best CyberChef Alternative: https://transformjs.com/alternatives/cyberchef

## Tool groups

- JSON Tools: https://transformjs.com/groups/json-tools
- Encoding Tools: https://transformjs.com/groups/encoding-tools
- Text Tools: https://transformjs.com/groups/text-tools
- Preview Tools: https://transformjs.com/groups/preview-tools

## Key facts

- Browser-based
- Privacy-first
- No installation
- No tracking
- Developer-focused utilities
